content: Kusanguka kua Yesu
Omo kuacele lia calumingo vampuevo vaile ku cihilo, vambate mazi avavuahesele.
Kaha vauanene livue liakama vana lihumisa ku cikolo ca cihilo.
Kaha vakovelelemo vuno honi kuuanenemo muvila ua Muene Yesu.
Vemanene kuje te valikomokela, kaha hajevene kuasholokele vamala vavali mu vuzalo vuakuviakuma kuli vakevo.
Vaje vampuevo vovuile liova cikuma kaha vakotamene ha mavu, vaje vamala vavehuile nguavo, “Vika mutondela muka muono ku vantsi?
Uahiko kuno nasanguka laja. Vulukeni muje muahandekele kuli yeni tele ali ku Ngalileya.
‘Muna Muntu vaka muhana mu mavako a vantu vavupi, kaha vaka mushukika, a kasanguka hanima ya matangua atatu.’ ”
Kaha vampuevo vavulukile mezi endi.
Kaha vahumine kuje ku cihilo vakalekele viuma vioshe vivamuene kuli vaje likumi na umo lia vandongisi na vakuavo voshe.
Vaje vampuevo vapuile Maliya Mangandalena, na Njuana, na Maliya vaina ya Yakomba na vampuevo vakuavo valekele evi viuma kuli tunganda va Yesu.
Vuno honi tunganda vasinganiekele nge vije vivahandekele vampuevo keti viaseho kaha kuva vakulahelele.
Vuno honi Petulu uakatukile na kushatukila ku cihilo, uakotamenenemo kaha uamuenemo lika vintanga na ceka cahi. Kaha uahilukile kuimbo na kulikomokela ha viuma vije via lingiuile.
Kuenda kuya kulimbo lia Emausi
Ha litangua lijevene vandongisi vavali va Yesu vendele kuya ku limbo lije liivatumbuile nguavo Emausi, ntunda yakele matambo likumi na imo kuhuma ku Yelusalema.
Vakele nakuhandeka ha viuma vioshe vije vialingiuile.
Tele vacili nakuhandeka na kuliyongola, Yesu uezile hayehi navo nakuenda navo.
Vamumuene vuno honi kuvamutantekeyele.
Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vimpande muka muli nakuhandeka oku muenda?” Vemanene kaha vihanga viavo viasolokele mu vusiua.
Kaha umo uavo lizina liendi Kolopase, uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Yove lika mungezi muno mu Yelusalema uje katantekeya vinapangika ha matangua ano.”

Kaha uavehuile nguendi, “Viuma muka?” Vamutavele nguavo, “Via Yesu uaku Nazaleta. Yala ou uapuile kananguizi ka Njambi na vantu voshe vamutavele kupua muka nzili mu viuma vioshe uahandekele na vije via lingile na Njambi uamu kulahelele.
Kaha tusasendote vakama na vakakuyula vamuhanene kuli Nguvulu ua Maloma linga vamutsihe, kaha vamushukikile ha cilindakano.
Tuakele na likulahelo nguetu ikeye akapatula Isaleli! Kaha lelo linapu litangua lia mucitatu kuhuma haje vialingiuile viuma evi.
Vampuevo vamo hhakati ketu vatukomokesele, vamenekelele ku cihilo cimenemene,
vuno honi kuvakauanene muvila uendi. Kaha vahilukile nguavo vakamuene cimona ca tungelo vaje vavalekele nguavo hali nakuyoya.
Kaha vamo hakati ketu vaileko ku cihilo, kaha vakauanene nge muje muvahandekelele vaje vampuevo, vuno honi kuvamumuene.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Yeni vilema, vaka kusimbula kutsiliela vije vioshe vivahandekele tunanguizi va Njambi va Njambi!
Nkumani Kilistu kapande kuyanda ha viuma evi nakukovela mu vumpau vuendi ndi?”
Kaha Yesu uaputukile kuvalumbuinina vioshe viuma vije vahandekele mu visoneka hali ikeye, kuputuka na mavulu a Mosesa na kutuala ku visoneka via tunanguizi va Njambi va Njambi voshe.
Kaha omo vahete kuyehi na limbo kuje vakele nakuya, Yesu ualingile ngue atuvakana kamandende kuya kulutue,
Vuno honi vamulombele na kuhandeka nguavo, “Tumama netu omuo cinguezi na litangua liatoko.” Kaha uaile na kukala navo.
Uatumamene navo mukulia kaha uambatele mbolo naku ikuisula uaipazuile na kuvahana.
Kaha mesho avo ashokolokele vatantekeyele nguavo nkumani ikeye, vuno honi ualavukile ku mesho avo.
Kaha valihandekesele umo na mukuavo nguavo, “Nkumani mukemo mitima yetu yovuile kuvuahelela cikuma omo uakele nakuhandeka netu mu ngila na kutulumbunuina viuma viamu visoneka.”
Vakatukile ha ntsimbu ijevene vahilukile ku Yelusalema, vauanene vandongisi likumi na umo vanalikungulula na vaje vakuavo veka naua.
Vahandekele nguavo, “Mua vusunga vene Muene Yesu nasanguka! Nalisholola kuli Simoni!”
Kaha vaje vavali vambuluile vije vialingiuile mu ngila, nomu vatantekeyele nguavo nkuma ikeye Muene Yesu omo uatavuile mbolo.
Yesu alisholola kuli vandongisi vendi
Tele ntsimbu vaje vavali vakele nakuvaleka viuma evi, vuasi vuasi Yesu vavenia uemanene hakati kavo uahandekele nguendi, “Ciyulo cikale neni.”
Kaha vovuile liova cikuma, omuo vasikaniekele nguavo vanamono ndumba ya muntu.
Vuno honi uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vikahoni munalijujukila? Omo vika muli na vimpata mu mitima yeni?
Taleni mavoko ange na mu viliato viange. Taleni yange vene. Njikuateni, kaha mutantekeya omuo nduma ya muntu kakele na ntsitu na vitsiha ngue evi muomono njili navio.”
Uahandekele evi na kuvamuesa mavoko na viliato viendi.
Cipue ngoco kuva kulahelele omuo vavuahelele cikuma na kulikomokela kaha Yesu uavehuile nguendi, “Muli na viakulia linga njilie ndi?”
Kaha vamuhanene mbazuvuila ya intsi uakuoca.
Kaha uaitambuile na kulia ha mesho avo.

Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Evi vikevio viuma vije njamilekele omo njakele neni nguange viuma vioshe vije vasonekele hali yange mu Lishiko lia Mosesa, na visoneka via tunanguizi va Njambi va Njambi na mu miaso viapande kulishulisisa.”
Kaha uashokoluele mana avo linga vovuisise visoneka
na kuhandeka kuli vakevo nguendi, “Visoneka viahandeka nguavio, Kilistu napande kuyanda kaha akasanguka hanima ya matangua atatu.”
Visoneka viahandeka naua nguavio linga kualuluka na lukonekelo lua vipi vaka viambulula mu lizina liendi ku mafuti oshe, kuputukila mu Yelusalema.
Yeni munapu muvakaleho ha viuma evi.
Kaha yange njikatuma Cimbembesi Cakulele kuli yeni cije cakulahesele Tate. Muapande kuvandamena mu mbonge noho mukatambula nzili ei kuhuminina muilu.
Yesu vamutuala muilu
Kaha uahumine navo mu mbonge uavatualele kuyehi na Mbeteniya kuje uajunduile mavoko endi naku vakuisula.
Tele hali nakuvakuisula, ualisezele navo nakumutuala muilu.
Vamushangazalele kaha vahilukile mu Yelusalema na kuvuahelela cikuma.
Kaha vakele ntsimbu yoshe mu njivo ya Njambi na kusantsela Njambi.
